description: Verify a Travel Rule packet you received from a counterparty: returns its stored risk level, recommendation, flags, threshold result and masked wallet addresses. Pass the packet_id you received and, optionally, the originator and beneficiary names and wallet addresses you hold; each is compared with what was screened and reported only as match true/false, so names are never revealed. Use it on the beneficiary side after receiving a packetId; use create_travel_rule_packet to create one. Free, no payment needed, limited to 60 calls per minute per client; an unknown packet_id returns a not-found error.

beneficiary_address.description: Optional beneficiary wallet address you hold

originator_address.description: Optional originator wallet address you hold

originator_name.description: Optional originator name you hold; checked against the stored keyed hash

packet_id.description: Packet id from the originator, TR- followed by 22 URL-safe characters

name: verify_travel_rule_packet

matches.description: Only when you passed values: originatorName, beneficiaryName, originatorAddress, beneficiaryAddress (true/false)

packet.description: packetId, screenedAt, riskLevel, recommendation, flags, travelRuleApplies, amountUsd, masked originatorAddress / beneficiaryAddress, namesProvided

title: Verify a Travel Rule Packet (Free)
